# External MCP Server Catalog - Sweep Log

Every discovery pass behind the [external MCP server catalog](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/), newest first. Each entry records what the mcpservers.org and mcp.so surfaces returned, which candidates were measured, and what was held and why.

## 🆕 November 23, 2026 - Midday Sweep (3 New, 3 Guides)

Fired on the **10:00 MST** tick, 5.5 hours after the night pass stored its **11:31Z** baseline and shipped four. The canonical did not move: the twelve numbered server maps returned **37,519** raw `<loc>` entries against **37,555**, the per-map block summing exactly (`4,156 / 2,526 / 2,941 / 3,231 / 3,342 / 2,939 / 5,857 / 2,739 / 2,617 / 2,616 / 2,515 / 2,040`), union keys **23,661** raw and **23,647** normalised against a **23,646** normalised baseline, a like-for-like diff of **+1 addition and 0 removals** where the addition is a locale route form of a slug already held, and **zero** `lastmod` rows at or after the cutoff - the newest stamp anywhere on the surface is **10:27Z**. All three products came from the push surfaces: the feed answered **200** at **159,050** bytes with **34** anchors, **30** stamps and five cards above the cutoff, and the queue carried **#7886** to **#7911**, twenty-six arrivals.

- [Koop MCP - Security Compliance Work From the Chat](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/koop-mcp/) - the catalog's first certification surface (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, CMMC L1 and L2, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS 252.204-7012, ISO 9001) at **from $299 a month**. Measured to the gate: a **401** whose body is an in-band JSON-RPC refusal naming both credential paths, a complete protected-resource document on the bare and the resource-relative route with three scopes (`koop:read`, `koop:write`, `koop:draft`), and an RFC 8414 document with PKCE **S256**, dynamic registration, revocation and `authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported: true`. The tool list is unreadable without an account, and the guide says so.
- [wapi.kz MCP - WhatsApp Leads Priced Back to the Ad](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/wapi-kz-mcp/) - submission **#7910**, the attribution slice of the WhatsApp story: **28** tools listed keyless on **wapi.kz 0.5.0** with every `tools/call` refused in band, all descriptions in Russian. A number attaches as a **linked device**, not the Cloud API. `get_analytics` rolls spend into leads into sales by campaign, ad set or ad; `list_leads` carries `ctwa` joins with the ad id and link joins with utm, fbclid and gclid; `match_method` names its own weakest link as a **15-minute** time window; six Meta tools reach the ad account and `set_ad_budget` warns that a budget change spends the client's money. **330 KZT per number per day**, first day charged on add, with `add_number` inert until `confirm=true`. Registry **0.5.1** against the endpoint's **0.5.0**.
- [RelayShield Scam Checks MCP - Keyless Fraud Screening](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/relayshield-scam-checks-mcp/) - submission **#7908**, four free keyless tools all driven: `check_link`, `check_email`, `check_breach`, `check_wallet`. Every clean answer reads `[UNKNOWN]` or a `LOW` risk qualified as unknown rather than safe. Two defects recorded rather than smoothed: `domain age=Noned` from a null template, and a batch path whose list disagrees with its own count (two URLs, "Checked 1 link(s)", one printed both as `[UNKNOWN]` and as `[NOT CHECKED - retry]`). A classic invoice-fraud subject and body scored **Risk low, Score 0** because the tool scores the fields supplied - the most useful fact in the guide.

**Also identified this pass (not catalogued).** Twenty-three queue arrivals held with the class or gate named: **CartAI** (agentic checkout, the one to revisit), **Scrumpy** (boards, `401` with no protected-resource document), **OnlyDNS**, **SentriSend** (signed receipts worth a second look on the saturated email-verification class), **AgentSDR**, **FlowFeed** (**$9 a month**, macro class), **Agent Meets Agent**, **DoLoop** and **Okokumo** (one author, two filings), **Oxynet**, **HenryCrawl** (**$19 a month for 3,000 credits**), three **Scrapemint** fronts as one actor fleet, **Tintloom**, **Rainfrog**, **Musikalis**, **One Design**, **Edgegap** (a listing correction, not a product), **Agent402 pay-mcp**, **HelmSwap**, **Solana Rent and Rug Shield**, **Agent Registrar**, **OrchStep**, **Palace** and **doubao-remote**, plus **#7906** recorded as a settlement address rather than a submission.

## 🆕 November 23, 2026 - Night Sweep (4 New, 4 Guides)

Fired on the **03:00 MST** tick, **5.6 hours** after the evening pass stored its baseline at **04:24Z**. The directory added **204** slugs and removed **none**, a wave concentrated in one map, while the queue carried **twenty-seven** arrivals and the feed **four** cards. Four products shipped, and each one prices something an operator otherwise guesses at: a tax rate on a date, a climate match between two towns, a delivered total in won, and a data stream's own inventory record.

- [Avanciq MCP - VAT Rates and Invoice Checks With Receipts](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/avanciq-mcp/) - a feed card at **09:53Z**, seven minutes before the read. Six tools, no auth. A German rate returns **19.0** standard and **7.0** reduced with the TEDB source, `source_read` **2026-11-12** and a receipt id; an invoice claimed at **119.90** is called `incorrect` against **119.99** with a **-0.09** difference reproduced by hand; **250,000** at **4.49** percent over **365** days returns `correct` at **11,225**; and the free `coverage` tool publishes **71** jurisdictions served, **30** not covered and the call price of every metered tool.
- [Climatch MCP - A Climate Match for Any City You Pick](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/climatch-mcp/) - submission **#7870** plus a sitemap arrival at `/servers/climatch-co-agents`. Nine keyless tools over 31,000 towns on TerraClimate 1991-2020: Lisbon at **28.3 C** in August and **680 mm** a year, Austin against Medellin a **6** match at **869** versus **2,482** mm of rain with both annual figures reproducing as exact monthly sums, London adjusted warmer returning Saint-Nazaire and Nantes at **87**, and Napa returning hardiness zone **9b** with wine grapes at **100** rainfed. `weather_for_the_money` is advertised and returns no data.
- [Moa MCP - Korean Prices Compared With Shipping](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/moa-mcp/) - submission **#7872**, twelve keyless Korean tools. **16,677** tumblers, ten shown with price, shipping and total on one line, **3** stale prices flagged and a `cursor` for the rest; one comparison link across **three** domestic and **two** overseas sellers; and the defect that matters, where the cheapest wireless-earbuds answer was a **1,700 won** cleaning brush, so the delivered-total logic is right and the relevance is not.
- [STRATA MCP - Sealed Data Streams Priced Per Call](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/strata-trashpan-mcp/) - a feed card at **06:01Z**, **118** tools over sixteen Japanese business-data streams. The free floor is an inventory probe that returns a sealed record (`checkCount 6`, `changeCount 3`, `firstSeenAt` **2026-11-07**, `lastCheckedAt` **2026-11-23T05:02:42Z**, a Merkle root and a Rekor batch dated **2026-11-23**), and the paid floor refuses cleanly at **0.006 USDC** a call over x402 with an Apify event and an API key as alternatives.

**Also identified this pass (not catalogued).** The wave decomposes into **12** Apify actor slugs, **67** documentation or marketing mirrors, **51** namespaced repository slugs and **74** plain product slugs, of which four were reached and the rest are named as not reached rather than dispositioned. Named for the next pass: `cheap-gpus-com-mcp` on the FinOps class, `contextbolt-com-seo` on the SEO and AI-visibility class, `llmdocs-dev` on docs retrieval, `invohub-app-connect-quickbooks` as an accounting connector, the `abigaildavised` five as prior dispositions re-entering under namespace slugs, and the `domainvet`, `linkvet`, `utilvet` and `livedproof` quartet as one author's pages fleet. Held from the queue and the feed with the gate or class named: the **HenryCrawl** ten (#7860 to #7869) and the **mambalabsdev** five (#7873 to #7877) on standing transport and fleet rulings; **Zero-Proxy MCP Suite** (#7884) as six Apify Standby endpoints behind one bearer key; **Flowmingo** (#7885) at **401** with a missing-credential challenge; **Conqueror** (#7882) at **401 invalid_token** with a protected-resource document on the SEO class; **past.dev** (#7880) with a **401** account server beside a keyless three-tool documentation server, on the memory class; **Reddit MCP** (#7879) on social data; **Nanobananana** (#7881) on media generation; **geolith** (#7859) at **401 missing_api_key** on geocoding; **Phation** (#7883) as local stdio; **Browsa** (#7871) on browser automation; **OpenSubtitles** (#7878) measured keyless and healthy at seven tools, held on the media and transcript class rather than refused on access; **pagesmith-ai** at **404** on `/mcp` and **401** with `read write deploy` at the bare host; and **memory-fit** at **401** in front of **107** tools over wearable health data.

## 🆕 November 22, 2026 - Midday Sweep (5 New, 5 Guides)

Fired on the **10:00 MST** tick, the first pass after the night sweep. The directory added **no products**: the union key set moved by one entry, a remote form of a slug already held, and the **+139** raw `<loc>` entries were a re-shard inside five maps (servers/12 +201, servers/1 -36). - [Fox Davidson MCP - UK Property Finance Calculators](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/fox-davidson-uk-mortgage-calculators-mcp/) - a feed card. Fifteen keyless UK calculators. Stamp duty at GBP 450,000 returns **12,500** in England and **17,750** in Scotland for a first-time buyer, both reproducible from the returned bands. A buy-to-let stress test reproduces three ways (11,225 at 4.49%, 13,750 at the 5.5% stress rate, ICR 1.50 and 1.22) and names the loan ceiling that passes: **210,658** at 145% ICR. Market rates carry a reviewed date of **2026-11-18**.
- [Daejeon Hankok MCP - A Korean City Priced Per Item](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/daejeon-hankok-mcp/) - submission **#7805**, a reversal of the night pass's scope hold recorded on evidence. **8,627** places and **1,863** stylists over **42** neighbourhoods, plus the Ministry of the Interior's **564** good-value shops with item prices dated **2026-10-18** (찐빵 500원, 아메리카노 1,000원). `get_place` refuses the ids its own search prints, recorded in the guide.
- [CLIA Sentinel MCP - US Lab Certificate Expiry Dates](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/clia-certificate-sentinel-mcp/) - submission **#7835**. A free sample returns a complete CLIA record: expiry **2027-10-19**, **332** days left, the 42 CFR 493.37(f)(1) window open from **2026-10-19** to **2027-01-19** with **59** days to close. It declares its own conflicts and refuses to price the penalties because they are adjusted yearly. The paid tool answers with an **x402** challenge of 0.01 USDC beside a documented three-call-a-day free trial.
- [eSIMX MCP - Travel eSIM Plans Priced in USD](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/esimx-mcp/) - a feed card. Two keyless tools. **37** Japan plans where 3GB for 7 days is **3.50 USD**; the **Europe 5GB 30Days** plan at **4.80 USD** covers **39** countries at the same price as Portugal alone; a Japan plus South Korea trip prices at **7.80 USD** for one plan and one installation. Requires the `MCP-Protocol-Version` header or `tools/list` fails at 400.

## 🆕 November 22, 2026 - Night Sweep (3 New, 3 Guides)

Fired on the **03:00 MST** tick, six hours after the evening pass closed at **04:02Z**. The directory served the same **37,102** raw `<loc>` entries and not the same map - three of the twelve moved while the total held - and seven keys carried a fresh stamp. The three products that shipped do one new job between them: checking a tool before it gets your keys, and pricing a GPU hour before it spends your money.

- [KitScout MCP - Vetting a Tool Before It Gets Your Keys](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/kitscout-mcp/) - submission **#7802**, four keyless tools over **61** categories summing to **94,077** indexed tools. `check_tools` returns `ok`, `caution` or `avoid` with the reason: our own endpoint reads `ok` with `daily_check: live (2026-11-21)` and `last_push_days 27`, two actively developed PrestaShop servers read `caution` at two and zero stars, and an archived official repository reads `avoid` with **543** days since its last commit. The response says what the verdict is not: *"ok is not a security or code review."*
- [CoreHu GPU Cloud MCP - Priced GPU Hours, Gated](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/corehu-gpu-cloud-mcp/) - submission **#7803**, six public tools, no key. **1,999** free machines at the read, A100 capacity from **0.77** USD/h in Japan against **2.99** in the US, **165** RTX 4090 offers from **0.72** an hour, and **518.40** USD for 720 hours that reproduces as 0.72 x 720. VRAM estimates carry their formula (**44** GB for 70B int4, **24** GB for 8B fp16 rounded up to a card), and the rental path is prepare-then-confirm with a **five-minute** confirmationId the user has to approve.
- [Lowdown MCP - Dated Facts About an MCP Server, Not a Score](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/lowdown-mcp/) - a sitemap arrival at **06:02:29Z**, two keyless tools and no verdict at all. Read against our own server it returns **27 / 27** daily checks answered since **2026-10-27**, **121** tools, **204 ms**, a schema hash, and definitions last changed **2026-11-06**; against CoreHu it returns `mixed` with a null tool count and the rotation stated. `find_servers does=prestashop` returns **0** where KitScout found four, because it does not search descriptions.

**Also identified this pass (not catalogued).** Nineteen held with the class or the gate named: **Krevaya** on the saturated social-scheduling class behind a paid-only plan; **ChinaMedsCheck**, **ChinaDocCheck**, **EsimTao**, **MahjongHandbook**, **TbmLib** and **ChinaTaxCalc**, six from one author, held on consumer verticals and on the tax and visa classes owned by Marsellus, Casus and Visamundi; **Agent Tollbooth 402** on the x402 mechanism class; **12happy** on uptime monitoring behind an API key; **Piqline**, driven keyless (30 of 258 professions, a guest answer reading *nous recrutons* at **110** live ads computed the same day) but held on the fourteen-owner ad-intelligence class; **jdx** and **flisk** as developer tooling; **archlang** on design tooling beside uCAD; **gesher** as an experimental Mac bridge; **mcp-film** and **post-engineer** as a directory and a one-star media generator; **Daejeon Hankok** as one Korean city; and **O'So for PrestaShop**, held because that slice already has four entrants and KitScout's own verdict on it is caution.

## 🆕 November 21, 2026 - Midday Sweep (4 New, 4 Guides)

Fired on the **10:00 MST** tick, seven hours after the night pass closed at **10:00Z**. Every reading of the canonical came back identical (**36,971** raw `<loc>` entries map for map, **23,220** distinct keys on both sides, **zero** `lastmod` rows at or after the cutoff, nothing in `/all` which has answered 403 since 4 November), so the whole window was the feed (two cards) and the queue (sixteen arrivals, **#7758** to **#7773**).

- [Europe Instead MCP - Sourced European Software Alternatives](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/europe-instead-mcp/) - submission **#7765**, five keyless tools over a directory where every vendor carries an origin score out of **100** and a data exposure level from **1** to **5**, each backed by a source URL, a quoted passage and a check date. Wire reads **100 / 100** with every part verified and the imprint quoted, and still exits at exposure **level 3** with `disclosed: false`; Brevo reads **93** at **level 4** with OVH in France and Google Cloud in Belgium named in its residency note. Slack returns **20** alternatives, `crm` returns **27** tools, and `max_level: 1` filters exactly.

a production mix maximising `40A + 30B` under `2A + B <= 100` labour and `A + 2B <= 80` machine hours returned **2,200** at `A = 40`, `B = 20` with labour at **100** of **100** and machine at **80** of **80**, both resources exhausted; a minimisation of `12x + 8y` returned **44** at `x = 1`, `y = 4` where the naive corner costs **48** and the other two corners cost **60** and **48**; and an integer model with both variables declared `General` returned whole numbers, `desks = 2`, `chairs = 3`, for **22** rather than a relaxed fractional answer. **The refusal is a first-class result:** a model whose constraints contradict returned `state: INFEASIBLE`, `optimal: false`, with the note *no solution satisfies all the constraints: the model is infeasible - or, occasionally, unbounded*, which is the vendor naming the one ambiguity a solver status cannot resolve on its own. **The limits are asked rather than discovered:** `environment` reports a Polar shared instance with **no licence key**, ojAlgo solvers only and `nativeSolvers: false`, a ceiling of **1,000** variables or constraints, a **30**-second suffice after which a result returns `FEASIBLE` unless it is proven optimal, and a **60**-second abort. **One gap recorded:** `translate` was driven only to its refusal (*'from' and 'to' are required, each LP, MPS or EBM*), so a successful round trip is unverified, and `solve` was exercised on LP and MILP but not on the QP and MIQP the server offers.

- [htsapi.dev MCP - US Tariff Classification Sources](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/htsapi-mcp/) - remote Streamable HTTP, stateless, no session id issued, at `https://htsapi.dev/mcp`, *htsapi* **1.0.0** on protocol **2025-06-18**, **eight** tools of which **seven** are keyless and were driven across **eleven** `tools/call` requests; registry `dev.htsapi/mcp` **1.0.0** published **2026-11-19T07:10:50Z**, queue entry **#7637** filed **07:11:28Z**. **This is the other half of [Tariff Monitor](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/tariff-monitor-mcp/) rather than a duplicate of it:** that entry prices the stack on ten-digit lines, this one serves the schedule one level at a time with the notes that decide between headings, the CBP rulings corpus with each ruling's status, and what importers actually paid. **The schedule is read, not guessed:** `lookup_hts_code` with no argument returned all **22** sections and their chapters in 18,207 characters, and on **6404** it returned **129** lines under three subheadings (**41 / 79 / 9**) with the newest rulings under the heading. **The notes are the argument:** `get_notes` returned chapter 64's exclusions verbatim, note 3's definition of rubber and plastics, note 4's rule that the material with the greatest external surface area decides the upper, and the subheading note that limits *sports footwear* to designated athletic categories. **Precedent works in both directions:** `search_rulings` on *led camping lantern* returned **three** rulings by meaning with the top hit at **0.736** similarity, code **8513.10.4000**, `status: current`, each carrying the product description CBP examined; `rulings_under_code` on **6403.99** counted **719** current rulings against **1** whose goods moved away. **The paid rate is the number nobody models:** `importers_paid` on **6404.11.20** from CN returned a general duty of **10.5** percent beside **29.8** percent in **2026-07**, **33.0** in **2026-08** and **34.7** in **2026-09**, the difference being Chapter 99 duties the response names and anti-dumping and countervailing duties it states are excluded. **Four limits recorded rather than smoothed:** Chapter 99 lines are refused by `lookup_hts_code` with a pointer to `importers_paid`; an eight-digit code in `importers_paid` falls back to the **HS6** group with `rate_pct: null` and the numbers in `months`; a heading carries no single rate (`general_duty: null` against aggregated subheading strings such as *10.5% / 7.5% / 37.5% / 48% / ...*); and `classify_product` refuses cleanly at **one credit**. The legal posture is stated by the vendor and worth keeping: CBP has ruled that an unlicensed platform suggesting codes beyond six digits for goods to be entered is conducting customs business, an importer may classify its own goods, and the free tools serve the sources while the paid classifier is labelled guidance rather than a binding ruling. Price: **50** calls a day per IP and **10** a minute keyless, **$9** a month for unlimited read tools under fair use, and classification credits at **100 for $10** or **1,000 for $50**. Freshness is published at `/v1/status`: USITC schedule synced **2026-11-16T02:02:45Z**, CBP CROSS **2026-11-17T04:33:16Z** with a newest ruling dated **2026-10-30**, Chapter 99 **2026-11-16T02:03:13Z**, none stale.

Two servers ship, both keyless and both driven, and both are first of their kind here: a European print-and-mail service that prices a letter before it is written, and a Sharia compliance screen that publishes every verdict change with its date.

A **236**-country destination list in five postage zones; **€4.20** for two pages to France itemised as envelope `0.23` + paper `0.28` + printing `0.30` + postage `2.78` = net `3.59`, VAT at 17% `0.61`, and every quote reconciling to the cent by hand; **€3.86** for one page to Germany; **€6.11** for four pages to the United States in **Z4** at 5-15 business days. **Registered mail is a flat €19.75 surcharge, not a percentage** - proven twice on two zones (€4.20 to €23.95 and €5.09 to €24.84) - and the one-page and registered prices come straight out of `list_destinations` for a country code. `send_letter` requires `letter_id`, `confirm` and `user_accepted_terms` against a specific draft, so the money gate lives in the schema rather than in the prompt. Two argument shapes are stricter than they look and were caught by sending the natural wrong form first: `country` must be an ISO two-letter code (*Too big: expected string to have exactly 2 characters*) and `color` is `bw` or `color`, not a boolean. **Limits recorded:** eleven of fourteen tools need an account and answer **401** `invalid_token` (`get_balance`, `list_letters` measured), the paper is European (DIN 5008, DL/C5/C4, printed in Germany, France, Belgium or Luxembourg), `fix_document_margins` **changes** a PDF rather than rejecting it, and only registered mail is trackable.

Public-service facts carry per-fact **source URL and check date** - address registration in Plovdiv at `1.02` EUR with the documents and the district counter, resident parking at `7.67` EUR a month quoting the article of the regulation - and Основа covers **120** entries and **514** facts across four cities with a content hash and the CC BY 4.0 attribution string served by the tool. Four defects recorded: `plovdiv-council` declared in `about_izvor` with **0** records, a change feed that timestamps a re-read of a 31 October notice as 13 November, street-level depth for one city only, and a Bulgarian-first surface.

**Also identified this pass (not catalogued).** Twenty-two queue arrivals were read with their bodies in one authenticated call and six feed cards were triaged. **Hundredth Run** GPU Cloud Prices holds on the GPU-price class owned by [GPU Finder](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/gpufinder-mcp/) with ReadyGPU second, its delta being keyless callability rather than new data. **Prax Data Services** holds on the payment and sanctions screening class carried by `mcp-sanctions`, QoreNext Trade Screening, Atlas Verified and Tiana, with the licence slice owned by the Ni Biashara disposition. **OffSeq Threat Radar** holds on the vulnerability class owned by Stackurity, `cve-now`, TrackCVE and VulX Watch. **PrivacyPill** holds on the consent class carried by [ConsentStack](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/consentstack-mcp/) and [iubenda](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/iubenda-mcp/). **InvoiceVerify** holds on the Peppol class, **KeyRank** on the saturated SEO class, **AstroCalc** as a consumer astrology utility, **Palimpalem** and **Spaicely** on the website-builder and hosting classes, **Google Flights**, **Google Jobs** and **YouTube Transcripts** on fare, jobs-data and video-transcript classes, **Planeja+** and **plat.plus** on project management and course platforms, **AdChat** and the rest of the feed cohort on ad-platform and SEO classes, and **Harbor** was already dispositioned on 12 November. **TehProf Dialogs** answers a keyless `initialize` with **401 `invalid_token`** and no metadata document, and **Enoki** with **401 `api_key_malformed`**, so both are held for a driven session on the messaging and agent-security classes rather than dismissed. `boomlink`, `assistant-24-7` and **Correctover Audit** are recorded as **unresolved** rather than absent: no registry record under the name forms tried and no detail route that would answer from this host.

## 🆕 November 13, 2026 - Night Sweep (2 New, 2 Guides)

Fired on the **03:00 MST** tick, six hours after the evening sweep closed. The window's first result was a correction of the last one: the **1,817 keys** the evening pass read as absent are back in the capture, all five of the slugs it named as untraceable are present, and the per-map counts show the only genuine movement was **248** raw entries in one map. Two servers ship, and both were driven rather than described - a document-and-spreadsheet join measured on a public demo key, and a payroll calculator installed from npm and re-checked by hand to the cent.

- [DocQuery MCP - Spreadsheet and PDFs, One Queryable Table](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/docquery-mcp/) - remote Streamable HTTP at `https://docquery.io/api/v1/mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0, sessionless, `initialize` **200** as `docquery-mcp` **1.0.0** on protocol `2025-06-18` with **tools, resources and prompts**, registry `io.docquery/docquery` **1.0.0** and **1.0.1**. The public demo key `dq_demo_readonly` drove **eight** `tools/call` requests against a linked workspace of **two** tables (4 customers, 6 invoices) joined by one declared foreign key, and **four** tools came back all annotated `readOnlyHint: true`. `query_table` reports `total` and `returned` separately so "three match" is never confused with "three fit in the answer", and one invoice carries **`total: 0`** with status `paid` - a real zero, not a missing field. The defect recorded is real: a **missing** required argument returns HTTP 200, `isError: true`, and the text **`Unknown tool: query_table`**, which sends an agent looking for a different tool instead of an argument.

- [CalcBloc MCP - Payroll Numbers With a Source Attached](/hermes/mcp/servers/external/calcbloc-mcp/) - local stdio, npm `calcbloc-mcp` **0.1.1**, registry `io.github.itmarkerz/calcbloc-mcp` **0.1.0** and **0.1.1**, MIT code and CC BY 4.0 data, **five** tools and **nine calls driven**. `$100,000` in California returned take-home **72,319.60** with the deductions itemised and four official sources dated. The federal figure was **reproduced by hand** from the 2026 single brackets the tool itself serves: **13,170.00** from a taxable 83,900 against the 16,100 standard deduction, against the **13,170.04** reported - the four cents being `506.54 x 26`, a biweekly rounding artifact and not an error. Coverage is stated three ways across the vendor's own surfaces (**37** countries in the package and registry, **37 tax tables / 12 calculators** from `list_countries`, **13 countries** on the developers page) and the tool is the honest one. Three frictions recorded: a per-country `region` requirement the schema cannot express, an enum hyphenated (`income-tax`) where the prose is not, and a keyless ceiling of **5 a minute and 50 a day**.

**Also identified this pass (not catalogued).** Sixteen queue arrivals were read with their bodies in one authenticated call and fifteen feed cards were triaged against the official registry. The **nine AdKit cards** inside **49** minutes are **one product**, not nine: `io.github.adkit/ads` answers the registry at **1.0.1** through **1.0.4**, all declaring the same remote `https://mcp.adkit.so`, whose keyless `initialize` returns **401** with `Authorization header with Bearer token required`, no `WWW-Authenticate` and no protected-resource document - a static token gate, the weakest evidence tier here, so campaign management across Google, Meta, TikTok, Reddit, LinkedIn and X holds on unmeasurability rather than on quality. **`agentmsgr`** (`com.agentmsgr/agentmsgr` **1.3.0**, **11** tools, agent group chat with approvals and wake links) is the closest call and holds on the agent-coordination class plus the same documentless 401. **AISend, CVPosh, GrowFast, Bugsly, SEOBolt and RemixViral** were filed by one account inside **eight seconds**, each with three public client-config repositories and private source - a publisher fleet dispositoned as one, with **SEOBolt** already covered by this catalog's SEO-audit depth. **Runner** holds on the AI-marketing-agent class owned by Marsell and Crevio; **Ironflow** holds on market data beside **TradingData** and **TradingAgentStack**; **Festapp** and **vstupenky.online** are one event-ticketing product filed twice by one submitter two seconds apart; **galatic-ai**, **splera** and the **`dash`** card sit in saturated media, experimentation and BI classes; **OpenDocKit** is named in the shipped DocQuery guide rather than duplicated. **`sportsgameodds`** and **`escro`** are recorded as **unresolved**, not absent - no registry record under any name form and neither detail route would answer from this host.
